title: Gravity A and gravity B in Barry's lab notes

tellings.quote: Barry had um, other lab notes, Mhm. and I don't know if those were previous docu- or documents that he had, but they were lab notes, and these this was the direction they were going in at one time.

plain: At S4, a secret site in Nevada where Bob Lazar says he worked on alien craft in the late 1980s, a colleague named Barry Castilio kept other lab notes describing two kinds of gravity, labelled A and B. Lazar tells Michels he does not know if they were older documents Castilio had, but they showed "the direction they were going in at one time." If so, the program had a working theory of gravity unknown to public science.
